note: Numbers only; no photos in the repo. Raw photos live in the git-ignored Data/Reference/raw/textures/Sailcloth/L0..L4/. Colour is CIELAB (D65) of the cloth after white balance, in the clew/foot area (0.1-0.6 m above the foot). L2 is measured; the other levels are estimates until photos are measured (see 'wanted').

references.licence: ours (Bean's own photo; shows people, never in the repo)
references.where: project files sailing-sim-ref/j22-lessons/1000032829.jpg (Oct 4 2026, overcast, Lake Ray Hubbard)
references.what: the lesson J/22 TX 7295 EC's mainsail at the clew: off-white cloth with tan clay smudges, a few brown specks, soft crinkle, the clew patch's zigzag stitching, a darker leech tabling
references.measure: python3 -I sailcloth_measure.py <photo> --cloth 20,300,230,800 --white 50,960,350,1080 (white = the white boom, albedo 0.80 assumed)
references.caveat: the sail is lit through from behind by the overcast and the boom's albedo is assumed, so its L* reads high; its hue (a*, b*) is the solid number

references.where: project upload e04e0fec (main and jib against the sun, sail tag on the jib)
references.what: a newer, crisper sail: smooth cloth, no visible stains; backlit, so used for look only, not colour

L0.source: estimate: new white Dacron with optical brightener reads slightly cool; no crinkle, no stains, no specks

L1.source: estimate: brightener fading, first folds at the flaking lines, the foot a shade greyer

L2.source: measured hue from bean-j22-clew (a* 0.83, b* 6.47); L* held at 85 (the photo's 89 is lifted by light through the cloth)

L3.source: estimate: kept 30-year-old Dacron is cleaned but yellowed by UV, soft and matt, crinkled all over; no mildew

L4.source: estimate: neglected 20-year-old sail, grey-brown dinge and tan smudges over the yellowing, mildew clusters low down
